legacy_columns.name: Key Findings
legacy_columns.note: Corrects blanket superiority and retains information conditions.

disagreement_records.original_value: Reported results (source excerpt): Three evaluations support the design: (1) under 48-hour autoregressive rollout the co-trained predictor degrades least (predictor degradation×1.06, against ×1.23–1.36 for two-stage designs and ×6.3–66 for curriculum ablations) while the co-trained encoder resolves the progression of patient state most sharply (largest state displacement); (2) the co-trained encoder separates deteriorating from stable patients in its latent space with Cohen’s d=1.59, against ≤0.50 for two-stage encoders; (3) one set of embeddings serves 34 downstream tasks across three benchmarks, outperforming strong per-task tuned baselines and a pretrained EHR foundation model.
disagreement_records.proposed_value: Factual-action h=48 degradation 1.06; observed-SOFA geometry d=1.59 [1.48,1.70]. Future-feature AUROC 0.845/0.838/0.884, AUPRC 0.367/0.482/0.595; LSTM E3 AUPRC 0.596. Future care and termination-dependent padding qualify gains; not every task/metric favors CLIN-JEPA.

scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification or replication. Earlier page calls reviewed every supplied page image/text; this synthesis read all text and notes but did not directly reinspect images.

Source path, binary availability and SHA-256 are supplied registry metadata, not independently recomputed. Evidence fragments were re-extracted with consistent source/version/page identifiers; earlier wrapped/mixed evidence content is not retained as a quotation.

The focal main configuration has all 128 feature dispositions. Auxiliary comparators retain their distinct reported diagnostics and architectural differences; they are not six independent studies or six independently completed 128-feature reviews.
Actual held-out MIMIC-IV clinical records support R2. Dataset release, code revision, comprehensive availability-time audit, code execution and independent reproduction remain unestablished.
Recorded future actions condition rollouts. For downstream forecasting they need not be available at the origin and may reveal management endpoints or evolving illness.

Readout construction stops at actual record end and zeroes later predictions. This conveys future observation duration despite no explicit length token; contribution to mortality/length-of-stay gains is not isolated.

The action stream mixes settable treatments and measured device/response variables. Procedure extraction sources are not all final text inputs. Duration/update, bundle, constraint and support semantics are incomplete.
Encoder-specific latent targets and scale-free ratios do not equalize target geometry or clinical difficulty. No decoded physiological fidelity or accepted clinical effective horizon is established.

Hour indices, admission laboratory content and changing documentation contribute to observed-state displacement. SOFA is part of the clinical input inventory; retrospective SOFA geometry is not independent discovery or admission-time prognosis.

Only selected complete-72-hour SOFA stays enter geometry analyses. Accuracy intervals condition on fixed centroids/neighbors; stay resampling is not training-seed uncertainty or necessarily patient-clustered inference.
Horizon populations change; window-level Wilcoxon inference may be affected by overlapping windows. One training seed is reported.
Ablation budgets, termination and evaluated checkpoints differ. Alignment and sync are jointly omitted. Irreversible-failure claims exceed demonstrated continuation experiments.
V-JEPA-style absolute-variance guard crossing must be distinguished from rank collapse; Appendix C explicitly qualifies the earlier language.
Co-training uses teacher-forced online embeddings, not free-running long-horizon encoder gradients. Main predicted rank still contracts substantially.
The authors' expected/conditional-mean interpretation is not established by an L1 objective; the review describes a deterministic latent point trajectory.
No matched alternative-treatment, causal identification, interventional validation, policy optimization, prospective utility or clinical authorization is demonstrated.
Bootstrap metric CIs do not establish predictive uncertainty or calibration. Deterministic rollout explicitly lacks uncertainty/multimodality.
Macro-means conceal heterogeneous tasks. LSTM prognosis AUPRC 0.596 exceeds CLIN-JEPA future-feature 0.595; every-column superiority is not supported.

CLMBR comparisons have differing coverage and input vocabulary. Matching covered stays does not equalize inputs. Sampled grids and shared multi-output sequence baselines qualify main-text tuning claims.
Measurement-dependent labels, lactate interpolation, stay-minimum creatinine, missing-dose negatives and differing time/date mortality rules require code-level scrutiny.
Code release is author-documented, not live-checked. Weights, licenses, ethics documentation, human reader evaluation, monitoring and change-control evidence remain unreported.
No files, graph admission, validation execution, external repositories or cited studies were accessed in this synthesis. Citation capabilities are not inherited.
